-- This module safely expands passed templates inside the Tooltip template.
local p = {}

-- Main Function
function p.main(frame)
    local args = frame:getParent().args

    local root = mw.html.create('span')
        :addClass('glossary')
        :attr('data-name', args.title or '')
        :attr('data-desc', args.content or '')

    if args[1] then
        root:wikitext(mw.text.unstripNoWiki(args[1]))
    end

    return tostring(root)
end

return p
